title: The Activity Geometry of Discrete Generative Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2611.32380v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Iterative refinement is a key capability of diffusion-based generation and has motivated growing efforts to bring similar behavior to discrete diffusion and flow models. A growing line of work enables such refinement by allowing previously generated tokens to be revised during sampling, thereby shaping the coupling between successive sampling states. Despite its growing role in sampler design, this coupling freedom remains insufficiently characterized. We introduce Activity Geometry to study these finite-step couplings through expected transition cost, which we call activity. We show that activity decomposes into the minimum required by the induced marginal transport and an excess term arising from the coupling. Using this minimum as a reference, we propose Minimal-Activity Finite-Time Coupling (MAFTC) to realize prescribed marginals with minimum activity without retraining or additional model evaluations. translated_title: 离散生成采样中的活动几何
translated_abstract: 迭代式修正是扩散生成模型的一项关键能力，这也推动了大量研究试图将类似行为引入离散扩散模型与流模型。越来越多的工作通过允许在采样过程中修改先前已生成的token来实现这种修正，从而塑造了相继采样状态之间的耦合。尽管这种耦合自由度在采样器设计中扮演着日益重要的角色，但目前对其刻画仍然不够充分。我们提出“活动几何”，通过期望转移代价（我们称之为“活动度”）来研究这些有限步耦合。我们证明活动度可以分解为由诱导边际传输所要求的最小值，以及由耦合产生的超额项两部分。以该最小值为基准，我们提出最小活动度有限时间耦合（MAFTC），无需重新训练或额外的模型评估，即可在最小活动度下实现指定的边际分布。在连续时间极限下，……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“活动几何”框架，将离散采样中逐步耦合的活动度分解为边际传输的最小代价与耦合超额项，并据此设计出无需重训、无需额外模型评估即可在最小活动度下实现指定边际分布并支持修正已生成token的MAFTC采样耦合方法。
en_tdlr: Introduces Activity Geometry, which decomposes the finite-step sampling coupling's "activity" into a minimal marginal-transport cost plus a coupling-induced excess term, and proposes MAFTC—a training-free, evaluation-free coupling that realizes prescribed marginals with minimal activity while enabling revision of previously generated tokens in discrete generative sampling.
